SELECT o.order_id p.product_name c.customer_name FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date > SYSDATE - 30
SELECT product_name price FROM products WHERE product_id = :pid
SELECT department_id COUNT(*) SUM(salary) AVG(salary) FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id ORDER BY SUM(salary) DESC
